stories.headline: UNEP warns adaptation finance remains far below developing-country needs
stories.summary: UNEP's Adaptation Gap Report 2026, released on 4 November, estimates developing-country adaptation needs of about US$305 billion annually by 2035.
stories.what_happened: UNEP reported international public adaptation finance of US$28.2–31.7 billion in 2024, only around US$1 billion higher than in 2023. Even tripling finance by 2035 would meet only 20–29% of needs.
stories.background: The gap is consequential for flood-prone countries including Pakistan and informs negotiations ahead of COP31.

stories.headline: US Treasury designates alleged false-flag shipping network linked to Iranian oil
stories.summary: On 4 November the US Treasury sanctioned an India-based network accused of issuing false flags and vessel certifications used by Iranian oil carriers.
stories.what_happened: Treasury designated Suniel Kumar Sharma, Jaspreet Preeti Shahid and associated entities under Executive Order 13902; it also designated Türkiye-based Fugo Ground Services in connection with Iranian aviation. These are US government allegations and actions.
stories.background: The case illustrates how maritime certification and shipping registries feature in sanctions enforcement and supply-chain risk.
